tagline: Gauntlet: four classes, one dungeon, friends join from one invite.
description:
Send Invite in the bar above. Extra adventurers walk into the same dungeon — warrior, valkyrie, wizard, elf.

On your own it is Jake Gordon's HTML5 dungeon crawler: pick a class, shoot the generators, grab the key, find the exit. Health ticks down on its own. Potions clear the room.

On a phone the pad is move, fire, and potion. On a computer it is the arrows or WASD, space to fire, enter for a potion. Your high score and how far you got are saved.

An unofficial port of HTML5 Gauntlet by Jake Gordon, MIT-licensed. This copy adds the extra adventurers. The dungeon is silent: the original music was licensed only for that project. Not affiliated with Namco.
